title: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
migration_provisions: Art. 12: freedom of movement, right to leave and return, right to seek asylum, ban on mass expulsion of non-nationals, expulsion of a lawfully admitted non-national only by a decision taken under law.
note: Dates from the AU list of human rights treaties. Not yet in migration-norms.csv, although cases under Art. 12 already are.

title: African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
migration_provisions: Art. 6 (name and nationality, child born stateless), Art. 23 (refugee children), Art. 25 (separated children).

title: Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol)
migration_provisions: Art. 4(2)(g) trafficking of women; Art. 10-11 women refugees and displaced women; Art. 13 work.
note: Dates from the AU list. Article numbers from background knowledge: check.

title: Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights Relating to the Specific Aspects of the Right to a Nationality and the Eradication of Statelessness in Africa
status_on_portal: not in force (AU page shows no entry into force date)
migration_provisions: Right to a nationality, safeguards against statelessness, nationality of children born on the territory, no arbitrary deprivation.

title: Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights on the Rights of Citizens to Social Protection and Social Security
status_on_portal: not in force (no entry into force date on the AU page)
migration_provisions: Social protection for citizens, with clauses on migrant workers and portability of benefits (check articles).
note: Adoption date from the AU page (6 February). The protocol covers citizens; migrant-worker clauses to be confirmed by reading.

title: Protocol on the Establishment of the East African Community Common Market
migration_provisions: Arts 7-10: free movement of persons and workers, right of establishment and residence; Annexes on free movement of persons and of workers.
note: PDF link from the EAC protocols page. Dates from background knowledge: check against the text. Applied by the EACJ in Mohochi v. Uganda (2013).

title: Protocol on Facilitation of Movement of Persons
migration_provisions: Visa-free entry for up to 90 days, residence and establishment, cooperation on immigration; not yet in force for lack of ratifications.
note: Document page: https://www.sadc.int/document/protocol-facilitation-movement-persons-2005. Signature date and status from background knowledge: check.

title: Protocol on Employment and Labour
migration_provisions: Labour standards across SADC including migrant workers, portability of social security and labour migration (check articles).
note: Page found on sadc.int; adoption date and status from background knowledge: check.

title: Decision 545: Andean Labour Migration Instrument
title_original: Decisión 545: Instrumento Andino de Migración Laboral
migration_provisions: Free movement and equal treatment of Andean migrant workers (individual, company, seasonal and border workers).
note: Gazette: https://www.comunidadandina.org/normativa-files//uploads/Gace938_65ee9bfdf1.pdf (Gaceta 938). Date is the gazette date shown on the portal. Replaces Decision 116 (1977).

title: Decision 548: Andean Mechanism for Cooperation on Consular Assistance and Protection and Migration Matters
title_original: Decisión 548: Mecanismo Andino de Cooperación en materia de Asistencia y Protección Consular y Asuntos Migratorios
migration_provisions: Consular protection of Andean nationals abroad by any member state consulate; migration cooperation.

title: Decision 583: Andean Social Security Instrument
title_original: Decisión 583: Instrumento Andino de Seguridad Social (sustituye la Decisión 546)
migration_provisions: Equal treatment and aggregation of contribution periods for Andean migrant workers.

title: Decision 878: Andean Migration Statute
status_on_portal: in force (CAN normative portal); amended by Decision 967 (2026)
migration_provisions: Right of Andean citizens to move, reside and work in member states; temporary Andean residence leading to permanent residence; equal treatment.

title: Treaty on the Eurasian Economic Union, Section XXVI (Labour Migration, Arts 96-98) and Annex 30
migration_provisions: Workers from member states need no work permit; recognition of diplomas; equal social security (except pensions) and medical care for workers and families.
note: Main source for Central Asian labour migration (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Armenia, Belarus, Russia). Article numbers from background knowledge: check.
